change_summary: Host's recommended fix. The pinch state now records the latest finger span (pinch.span), updated on every two-finger touchmove. When the ResizeObserver callback actually changes the zoom (zoom.current !== was) during a held pinch, the pinch is rebased to { distance: latest span, zoom: corrected zoom }. Callbacks that leave the zoom unchanged (scrollbar changes, unclamped resizes) leave the pinch untouched. Drag code, zoomTo, zoomAtCenter, zoom.ts, index.css and Viewer.tsx are unchanged.

side_effects: Accepted per order: pastMax case. Fingers spread from 100px to 150px at the 390px maximum, then a resize to 844x390 clamps to 379%. The pinch-in dead zone is now gone and the page shrinks at once: 140px -> 354% (2986.66px), 100px -> 253%, 90px -> 227%. On 43155a5 it stayed at 379% down to 100px, then 341% at 90px.
